content: Nein Selopehad Serepein kei
Mahla, Noha, Okla, Milka, oh Tirsa, ih serepein pwukat me nein Selopehad, Selopehad, nein Eper, Eper nein Kilead, Kilead, nein Makir, Makir, nein Manase, Manase nein Sosep.
Irail kohla oh kesihnenda mwohn Moses, samworo Eleasar, kaun akan oh mehn Israel ko koaros ni wenihmwen Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale oh patohwan,
“At pahpao mehla nan sapwtehno sohte nah pwutak. E sohte iang iengen Kora ko me kahngohdiong KAUN-O; e mehkihla pein dipe.
Pwehki eh sohte nah pwutak, ia kahrepen eden at pahpao eh pahn sohrala sang wehin Israel? Kumwail ketikidohng kiht at sohso sang rehn en pahpa peneinei kan.”
Moses eri patohwanohng KAUN-O ar pekipek,
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong,
“En nein Selopehad serepein kan ar pekipek me pwung; ke pahn kihong irail arail sohso sang rehn kisehn arail pahpao. En arail pahpa eh sohso en kohieng irail.
Ndaiong mehn Israel kan me ahnsou me ohl emen pahn kin mehla sohte nah pwutak, nah serepein me pahn ale sohso.
Ma sohte nah serepein, rie pwutak kan me pahn ale sohso.
Ma sohte rie pwutak, rien eh pahpa ohl akan me pahn ale.
Ma sohte rie de rien eh pahpa, a kiseh me keieu karanih me pahn sohsohki oh wiahkihla uhdahn ah. Mehn Israel kan pahn kin kapwaiada koasoandi wet, nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, ei mahsanihong uhk.”
Moses Idihada Sosua Wiliepe
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses, “Kohdahwei pohn Nahna Aparim; ke ahpw pahn kilang sang wasao sahpw me I pahn kihong mehn Israel kan.
Mwurin omw pahn kilang sahpwo, ke pahn mehla, duwehte riomw Aaron,

pwehki amwa sapeikiong ei mahseno nan sapwtehn en Sin. Ni ahnsou me mehn Israel koaros pelianiehda nan Meripa, kumwa sohte uhkihda roson en ei manaman sarawi mwohrail.” (Meripa, iei utuhnpihl me mi nan Kades nan sapwtehn en Sin.)
Moses eri kapakap, patohwan,
“Maing KAUN, Koht me wia poahsoan en mour koaros, I peki komwi en ketin kilelehdi ohl emen me pahn kin kaweid aramas pwukat,
oh kaunirailda nan mahwen, pwe sapwellimomwi aramas akan en dehr rasehng pelin sihpw me sohte silepahr.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Ale Sosua, nein Nun, pwe ih ohl koahiek men, kowe eri kidahng pehmw kan pohn moange.
E ahpw pahn patohda mwohn samworo Eleasar oh aramas akan koaros. Ke ahpw pahn pakairkihong irail koaros me iei ih wiliepomw.
Ke ahpw pil kihong apalien omw manaman, pwe mehn Israel kan koaros en peikiong.
E pahn peikiong samworo Eleasar, me pahn esehkihla kupwurei Urim oh Dumim.
Ih duwen met me Eleasar pahn kaweidki Sosua oh pil mehn Israel kan mehkoaros me irail pahn kin wia.”
Moses eri kapwaiada me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong. Ih eri ale Sosua oh kahrelahng rehn samworo Eleasar mwohn mesen mehn Israel kan koaros.
E ahpw kidahng peh ko pohn moangen Sosua, oh pakairkihong aramas ako me iei ih wiliepe, nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsaniher.

footnotes.text: URIM OH DUMIM: Kisin takai riau me samworo kan kin doadoahngki pwe re en rapahkihki kupwur en Koht; sohte me ese duwen ar kin doadoahngki.
